prompts.guardian: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game sprite animation atlas, genuine transparent alpha background. Create a 4 by 4 perfectly regular grid of 16 isolated animation frames, large square atlas. Supporting reference image is ONLY character identity/style: armored cave guardian made of charcoal rock, turquoise crystals on shoulders and forearms, bright teal eyes and circular bronze chest core. Keep that exact character recognizable. Draw each frame at matching scale and feet anchor, viewed front three-quarter from a slightly elevated 2D RPG camera. Polished hand-painted sprite art, crisp clean edges, detailed enough for 160–224px display, no coarse pixel grid. ROW1 left to right: heavy slam anticipation with both arms raised, arms descending, crouched impact, standing recovery. ROW2: sweeping arm anticipation, left sweep, right sweep with open palm, recovery. ROW3: leaning forward charge anticipation, low forward charging pose, braking pose, recovery. ROW4: summoning hands raised slightly, raised hands radiating blue small runes, arms fully raised, relaxed recovery. All frames isolated within their cells with generous transparent gutters, no effects crossing cells. No labels, no gridlines, no backgrounds, no scenes, no floor slabs, no extra characters, no contact shadows baked into alpha. Same body proportions and centerline in all cells. Preserve real transparency. This is a new animation sheet derived from the reference, not a scene illustration.
